reviews.text: leaves the skin very glowy. it smells amazing just like the rest of this line. I honestly love to use this one in the mornings. sometimes instead of moisturizer. it feels honestly a bit like a moisturizer because its thicker than most emulsions I've tried. so I would say it's kind of like a hybrid between an emulsion, a lotion and a cream.
reviews.zh: 令皮膚好有光澤。佢嘅香味好好聞，同呢個系列其他產品一樣。我真係好鍾意早上用呢款，有時會代替保濕霜用。用落真係有啲似保濕霜，因為佢比我試過嘅大部分乳液都要稠身。所以我會話佢似係乳液、潤膚露同面霜嘅混合體。

reviews.text: this is nice. I'd prefer there wasn't added fragrance but my skin does love propolis. this is very moisturizering and feels great sinking into the skin. it doesn't take long to sink in on my very dry skin and it does leave a glow. I use it as my last step before moisturizer and sunscreen before makeup and it's never caused piling. I do like this.
reviews.zh: 幾好。我希望佢冇加香料，不過我嘅皮膚好鍾意蜂膠。呢款好滋潤，搽落皮膚好舒服。喺我非常乾燥嘅皮膚上，佢都唔使好耐就吸收晒，而且會留低光澤。我會用佢作最後一步，喺保濕霜同防曬之前搽，然後先化妝，從來冇搓泥過。我真係幾鍾意呢款。

reviews.text:

The bottle is huge and has alot of products
its very creamy texture that leaves such an amazing glow on my skin.
it never broke me out

reviews.zh:
我係憑直覺買嘅，因為我知道 skinFood 嘅保濕產品最好，而我好慶幸自己買咗！
支樽好大，入面有好多產品。
質地好綿密，令我皮膚有好靚嘅光澤。
佢從來冇令我爆痘。
好滋潤，好啱寒冷嘅天氣用。
我好鍾意佢🥰

reviews.text: RECOMMEND SOOO GOOD ITS MY FAVORITE!!! It has made my face so glowly it is so hydrating. I had my doubts at first but this definitely blew me out of the water. I’ve had noticed a vast difference in my skin and have gotten SOO many compliments on my skin. Definitely aged me back and has made my skin look like glass and feel so refreshed and hydrated. I have dry skin, and had been breaking out lately this just fixed it all. I recommend this to anyone that I see
reviews.zh: 超推薦，好好用，係我嘅最愛！！！令我面好有光澤，好水潤。起初我有啲懷疑，但呢款真係令我大感驚喜。我發覺皮膚有好大改變，而且好多人讚我皮膚好靚。佢令我睇落年輕咗，皮膚似玻璃咁透亮，摸落清新、水潤。我皮膚乾，最近一直爆痘，但用咗呢款就全部解決晒。我見到人都會推薦畀佢哋。

reviews.text: i never leave reviews but this is so good, i'm making an exception. lightweight enough for the summer but still moisturizing enough for the winter. never pills, so it works great layered under spf or a thicker moisturizer or face oil. i'm on my 5th bottle and have 1 backup ready to go because i can't be without it.
reviews.zh: 我好少寫評論，但呢款實在太好，所以破個例。夏天用夠輕盈，冬天用又夠滋潤。從來唔會搓泥，疊喺防曬、厚啲嘅保濕霜或者面油下面都好好用。我而家用緊第五樽，仲有一樽後備，因為冇佢唔得。

reviews.text:
A light and gentle emulsion that nicely bridges my toner/serum step and occlusive moisturizer step for my nighttime routine. Also works wonderfully as a daytime moisturizer in hot and humid days. It is hydrating and calming, yet lightweight enough that it is almost refreshing. 

The texture is a very lightweight cream, and not at all watery/liquidly or serum-like. Spreads beautiful on my skin and does not leave a tacky finish afterwards. With a pump top, you can easily dispense the product in a controlled manner. 3 pumps are the perfect amount for me, and again with this line, a little goes a long way. If you find it a bit too tacky, try using less product, and evenly dotting it around your face before spreading with your fingertips. 

Stunning packaging and a convenient pump top. A hard plastic bottle and cap that resembles glass and metal, while being resilient to drops and accidents. I don’t think I can find a fault in the packaging, unless the visual style is not your cup of tea. Should look amazing on a glamorous vanity, alas I use my computer desk for my skincare routines, so it is a bit too luxurious for my modern setup. Still looks amazing in my cupboard though!

So far this is a very versatile product and I enjoy it a lot. Would recommend to anyone looking for a lightweight cream that still locks in some moisture and keeps your skin hydrated in not-so-extreme environments. And with such a large bottle, I am sure it will last for a long time.
reviews.zh:
一款輕柔嘅乳液，對我嘅晚間護膚步驟嚟講，啱啱好銜接咗爽膚水／精華同封閉式保濕霜。喺炎熱潮濕嘅日子，佢做日間保濕霜都好好用。佢保濕又舒緩，而且質地夠輕，用落幾乎有清新感。

質地係好輕嘅面霜，一啲都唔水水或者似精華咁。推開好服帖，之後唔會有黏膩嘅感覺。有壓嘴，可以好容易咁控制出量。三下壓嘴對我嚟講剛好夠，而且呢個系列再次證明，少少就夠用。如果覺得有啲黏，可以試吓減少用量，喺面上平均點幾點，再用指尖推開。

包裝好靚，壓嘴都好方便。樽同蓋係硬膠，睇落似玻璃同金屬，唔怕跌或者意外撞擊。我覺得包裝冇乜問題，除非你唔鍾意嗰種視覺風格。放喺華麗嘅梳妝枱上應該好好睇，可惜我係用電腦枱做護膚，所以對我呢個現代化嘅設置嚟講有啲太奢華。不過放喺我個櫃入面都好靚！

到目前為止，呢款係好多用途嘅產品，我好鍾意。推薦畀想搵一款輕盈面霜、又可以鎖住啲水分、喺唔算極端嘅環境下保持皮膚水潤嘅人。而且樽裝咁大，我相信可以用好耐。

reviews.text: First time trying this brand and particular line of products and I'm blown away. First couple of uses it made my skin feel super soft and non sticky! My skin is a dry oily type that is not sensitive, but I can tell it has a lot of fragrance. Beware sensitive skin friends if fragrance makes you break out.
reviews.zh: 第一次試呢個品牌同呢個系列嘅產品，我真係好驚喜。頭幾次用，皮膚摸落超級軟滑，又唔黏！我嘅皮膚係乾性油皮，冇敏感，但係我覺得佢嘅香味好重。如果香味會令你爆痘，敏感肌嘅朋友要留意。

reviews.text: I bought this, because I love the serum of this line. Also have the toner. But, toner and the emulsion unfortunetelly have too much fragrance in it, which the serum doesnt have. They feel nice and nourishing, but I will not repurchase it. My very sensitive skin doesnt react too well to too much fragrance.
reviews.zh: 我買呢款係因為我好鍾意呢個系列嘅精華。我都有佢嘅爽膚水。不過，爽膚水同乳液都有太多香味，精華就冇。用落感覺幾好、幾滋養，但我唔會再買。我嘅皮膚好敏感，對太多香味反應唔係幾好。
